From 657a091ab6d01d0091b77660c75cfed573c9a53e Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Johan Hovold <johan@kernel.org>
Date: Fri, 8 May 2026 16:44:45 +0200
Subject: [PATCH] drm/gma500/oaktrail_lvds: fix hang on init failure

The LVDS init code looks up an I2C adapter using i2c_get_adapter() and
tries to read the EDID before falling back to allocating and registering
its own adapter.

The error handling does not separate these cases so on a late init
failure it will try to deregister and free also an adapter that had
previously been registered. Since i2c_get_adapter() takes another
reference to the adapter, deregistration hangs indefinitely while
waiting for the reference to be released.

Fix this by only destroying adapters allocated during LVDS init on
errors.

Fixes: a57ebfc0b4da ("drm/gma500: Make oaktrail lvds use ddc adapter from drm_connector")
Cc: stable@vger.kernel.org	# 6.0
Cc: Patrik Jakobsson <patrik.r.jakobsson@gmail.com>
Signed-off-by: Johan Hovold <johan@kernel.org>
Signed-off-by: Patrik Jakobsson <patrik.r.jakobsson@gmail.com>
Link: https://patch.msgid.link/20260508144446.59722-3-johan@kernel.org

diff --git a/drivers/gpu/drm/gma500/oaktrail_lvds.c b/drivers/gpu/drm/gma500/oaktrail_lvds.c
index 884d324f0044..983cc60a1e69 100644
--- a/drivers/gpu/drm/gma500/oaktrail_lvds.c
+++ b/drivers/gpu/drm/gma500/oaktrail_lvds.c
@@ -293,7 +293,7 @@ void oaktrail_lvds_init(struct drm_device *dev,
 {
 	struct gma_encoder *gma_encoder;
 	struct gma_connector *gma_connector;
-	struct gma_i2c_chan *ddc_bus;
+	struct gma_i2c_chan *ddc_bus = NULL;
 	struct drm_connector *connector;
 	struct drm_encoder *encoder;
 	struct drm_psb_private *dev_priv = to_drm_psb_private(dev);
@@ -421,7 +421,8 @@ void oaktrail_lvds_init(struct drm_device *dev,
 
 err_unlock:
 	mutex_unlock(&dev->mode_config.mutex);
-	gma_i2c_destroy(to_gma_i2c_chan(connector->ddc));
+	if (!IS_ERR_OR_NULL(ddc_bus))
+		gma_i2c_destroy(ddc_bus);
 	drm_encoder_cleanup(encoder);
 err_connector_cleanup:
 	drm_connector_cleanup(connector);
-- 
2.34.1

### Summary of the Bug Fix Patch

#### Modified File: `drivers/gpu/drm/gma500/oaktrail_lvds.c`

**1. Initialization of `ddc_bus` variable (line 296)**
- **Before:** Variable `ddc_bus` was declared without initialization.
- **After:** Variable `ddc_bus` is explicitly initialized to `NULL`.
  - *Purpose:* Clear default to distinguish between cases where no internal DDC adapter was allocated (i.e., when an external I2C adapter was used via `i2c_get_adapter`).

**2. Error‑handling path (`err_unlock` label, lines 424–425)**
- **Before:** The code unconditionally destroyed the DDC bus by reading from `connector->ddc`:
  ```c
  gma_i2c_destroy(to_gma_i2c_chan(connector->ddc));
  ```
- **After:** The code conditionally destroys `ddc_bus` only if it is a valid internally allocated adapter:
  ```c
  if (!IS_ERR_OR_NULL(ddc_bus))
      gma_i2c_destroy(ddc_bus);
  ```
  - *Purpose:* When init fails after successfully obtaining an external I2C adapter (via `i2c_get_adapter`), the external adapter should **not** be destroyed – only its reference should be put (already handled elsewhere). Previously, destroying it caused a hang because `i2c_get_adapter` holds an extra reference that must not be freed by `gma_i2c_destroy`. Now the error path only frees adapters that were allocated internally during LVDS init.

#### Relationship Between Modifications
The two changes work together to fix the hang on init failure:
- Initializing `ddc_bus` to `NULL` ensures that after a successful `i2c_get_adapter()` call, `ddc_bus` remains `NULL` (it is not overwritten by the internal allocation path).
- The conditional destruction then only applies when `ddc_bus` points to an internally allocated adapter (i.e., when the init code actually created its own DDC channel). This prevents erroneously attempting to deregister and free an external I2C adapter, which would wait indefinitely for the extra reference to be released.

You are a programming expert.

The code statements that lead to the bug are:
`gma_i2c_destroy(to_gma_i2c_chan(connector->ddc));`
Reason:
When the LVDS init code obtains an I2C adapter via i2c_get_adapter() (instead of allocating one internally), the connector->ddc pointer is set to that external adapter. The error path unconditionally calls gma_i2c_destroy() on connector->ddc, which attempts to deregister and free the adapter. Since i2c_get_adapter() holds an extra reference, the deregistration waits indefinitely for that reference to be released, causing a hang.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
`if (!IS_ERR_OR_NULL(ddc_bus))`
`    gma_i2c_destroy(ddc_bus);`
Reason:
The fix introduces a local variable `ddc_bus` initialized to NULL, which is set only when an internal adapter is allocated via oaktrail_lvds_i2c_init(). The error path now destroys only that internal adapter (when not NULL/error), avoiding destruction of an externally obtained adapter. This prevents the hang by ensuring no attempt is made to deregister or free an adapter that was not allocated by the driver.
